annotations.title: Etapa sign-up: build the rider's guide

description: Saves the rider's answers to their Etapa account and starts building their guide, as the app does. Every agreement must be true. Building takes a minute or two: call `etapa_get_guide` next.

activity.description: How much exercise they do now, of any kind

goal.description: What to build up to: `habit` (25 km), `endurance` (50 km) or `century` (100 km)

weeks.description: How long the guide runs, in weeks

companion.description: Who guides them; matteo for a new rider with no preference. Leave out for a rider who has one and didn't ask to change

consent.description: All four agreements, each answered yes by the rider

aiCompanion.description: They understand their companion is an AI

healthNote.description: They consent to the health note: guidance, not medical advice, and Etapa processing the health details they share

termsAndPrivacy.description: They agree to the terms of use and privacy policy

cyclingFrequency.description: When they last rode a bike, or how often they ride

bikes.description: The bikes they ride; `indoor` for a trainer

event.description: The event they're training for (`find_goal`), as `etapa_find_event` found it

distanceKm.description: The distance they're riding, in km

elevationM.description: Its climbing in metres, if known

weeks.description: Only for a guide to stay fit. For an event, leave it out: the guide runs from the start date to the event

intent.description: What they want: `getting_started` or `returning` takes `beginner`; `find_goal` or `fitter` takes `guide`

longestRide.description: Their longest ride in the last 3 months, as a band

longestRideKm.description: Or the distance in km, if they gave a number

name: etapa_build_guide
title: Etapa sign-up: build the rider's guide
